values.value: Marketing Cloud Next runs on Data Cloud. With no Data 360 footprint in place, the Foundation phase gates every other lane — journey, content and campaign work cannot complete before the data layer exists. Budget 8-16 weeks of foundation before migration build starts, plus 4 weeks if Identity Resolution is not yet configured. This does not change the readiness score: the estate may well be easy to move, and still not be movable yet.

skills/mce-mcn-helper/references/skills/10-roadmap.md — Step 2, "Foundation always runs first and gates the other swim lanes"; Data Cloud not yet started = 8-16 weeks, Identity Resolution unconfigured = +4 weeks.
